verdict.rationale: The only bulk-style capability in the evidence is reporting: Stripe Tax offers three kinds of reports, and its itemized exports give a line-item tax breakdown for every transaction, which amounts to a bulk read/export. Nothing shows batch writes, such as bulk tax calculations, bulk product tax-code assignment or bulk registration updates, and the Tax Calculations API is documented per request. Missing for 10: batch/bulk API endpoints for calculations or transactions, bulk updates to product tax codes or registrations, CLI/MCP bulk workflows, and independent hands-on corroboration of bulk operations.
